business_one_liner: Plant tissue culture biofactory for biofungicide (ABM-01) and vaccine adjuvant (QS-21) from Quillaja saponaria.
description: Develops plant tissue culture as living biofactories cultivating Quillaja saponaria trees for producing biofungicide (ABM-01) targeting multiple crop diseases and vaccine adjuvant (QS-21). Established partnerships with Syngenta (seeds), Croda (extraction), and major pharmaceutical companies. University of Chile spinoff with 11 years of commercial operation demonstrating reproducible manufacturing scalability.
source: Universidad de Chile spinoff, international partnerships (Syngenta, Croda)

business_one_liner: Bacterial biofortificants (CRIOPROTECT frost protection, NANOFORTE soil biotech) from Antarctic and Atacama extremophiles for crop resilience.
description: Develops biofortificant products from Antarctic and Atacama microorganisms: CRIOPROTECT provides frost protection via Pseudomonas pewmanensis (naturally isolated in Antarctica) and NANOFORTE uses combined microbial consortia with oxygen nanobubbles for enhanced soil functionality. Funded by CORFO, ANID, and FIA for climate-resilience agriculture. Winner of Mercurio 2024 Startup of the Year award. Demonstrates proof-of-concept with public funding totaling $1M+ and award recognition.

business_one_liner: Biological crop protection and nutrition products with leading registrations across LATAM.
description: Chilean leader in biological input product registrations across Brazil and LATAM with specialized expertise in biocontrol and biological fertilizers. Focuses on crop protection and nutrition through biological mechanisms (beneficial microorganisms, bioactive compounds) as alternatives to chemical inputs. Demonstrates market presence and regulatory pathway knowledge across multiple jurisdictions.

business_one_liner: Microbiome intelligence platform (Micro-ID) translating microbiome analysis into operational recommendations for aquaculture and agriculture.
description: AI-powered microbiome analysis platform identifying agricultural microbiome composition and translating results into operational optimization recommendations for aquaculture and crop production. Winner of Startup Chile 2026 (Banco de Chile) award. Based in Puerto Varas with focus on salmon industry application and broader agricultural use. Demonstrates award recognition and institutional backing.
source: Banco de Chile Startup Chile 2026 Award, ANID collaboration

business_one_liner: Agricultural biotechnology developing precision solutions for crop genetic improvement and resilience.
description: Develops precision biotechnology solutions for crop improvement targeting enhanced yield, disease resistance, and climate resilience. Limited public information but identified through Chilean startup ecosystem databases as agtech startup with biotechnology focus.

sector: Marine biotech, seaweed-derived bioinputs, organic agriculture
business_one_liner: Marine-derived bioactive products from Patagonian seaweed for organic and conventional agriculture.
description: Produces bioactive products from Patagonian seaweed and marine sources for agricultural application in both organic and conventional farming systems. Leverages unique Patagonian marine biodiversity for crop protection and nutrition solutions. Demonstrates regional/IP advantage from Chilean geography.

business_one_liner: Novel microprotein superfood via bioconversion of macroalgae with edible fungi consortium for alternative proteins and soil inputs.
description: Develops microprotein alternative protein source through directed bioconversion of macroalgae using edible fungi consortium. Founded by biotechnologist Catalina Landeta. CORFO Crea y Valida program funded (Chilean government biotech innovation). Combines marine biology with fermentation biotechnology. Secondary relevance to crop resilience through organic waste valorization and potential biofertilizer applications.
source: CORFO Crea y Valida (Government biotech innovation program)
